description: A service account of an Amazon Managed Grafana workspace, made with CreateWorkspaceServiceAccount. AWS assigns its Id. AWS has no call that changes a service account, so every property is create-only. Radius doesn't make its tokens, because AWS returns a token only once.

WorkspaceId.description: The ID of the workspace the service account belongs to.

Name.description: The name of the service account. It must be unique within the workspace.

GrafanaRole.description: The permission level of the service account.

Id.description: The ID AWS gave the service account.

IsDisabled.description: "true" when the service account is disabled, which is done in the Amazon Managed Grafana console.
